cohort: The study included 100 pregnant women with gestational age >= 20 weeks, consisting of 50 clinical cases of preeclampsia and 50 healthy normotensive pregnant women.
finding: Preeclamptic women exhibited significantly lower mean serum vitamin D levels (9.76+/-3.19 ng/ml) compared to healthy normotensive pregnant women (19.57+/-6.37 ng/ml).
cross-section timing: During pregnancy at gestational age >= 20 weeks
